sql: WITH daily_sales AS (SELECT d.DateKey, d.IsHoliday, sum(s.SalesAmount) as sales FROM retail.FactOnlineSales s JOIN retail.DimDate d ON s.DateKey = d.DateKey GROUP BY d.DateKey, d.IsHoliday), avgs AS (SELECT IsHoliday, avg(sales) as avg_sales FROM daily_sales GROUP BY IsHoliday) SELECT round((h.avg_sales - r.avg_sales) * 100.0 / r.avg_sales, 2) as pct_difference FROM avgs h, avgs r WHERE h.IsHoliday = 'Yes' AND r.IsHoliday = 'No'
